description: OWNER ONLY — after posting on @NewsGurus, record the post's internal signature. post_url = the x.com status URL; writer_agent / poster_agent = who wrote and who posted it (e.g. Researcher / NG-Reply); text = the exact text that went out; format = brief|reply|quote|video|breaking|scorecard|eod|thread_leg|single|other; source_file = the newsletter path. Returns the weighted character count. Never posts anything. Requires an OWNER-tier API key.
name: record_x_post
